type.description: Package type, either 'library' for common packages, 'composer-plugin' for plugins, 'metapackage' for empty packages, or a custom type ([a-z0-9-]+) defined by whatever project this package applies to.

target-dir.description: DEPRECATED: Forces the package to be installed into the given subdirectory path. This is used for autoloading PSR-0 packages that do not contain their full path. Use forward slashes for cross-platform compatibility.
target-dir.deprecated: Deprecated in favor of PSR-4 autoloading; kept for legacy projects, no removal scheduled.

readme.description: A relative path to the readme document. Defaults to README.md. Mainly useful for packages not on GitHub, as Packagist.org will use the readme API to fetch the one detected by GitHub.

items.description: A tag/keyword that this package relates to.

version.description: Package version, see https://getcomposer.org/doc/04-schema.md#version for more info on valid schemes.

time.description: Package release date, in 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ' format.

license.description: License name. Or an array of license names.

authors.description: List of authors that contributed to the package. This is typically the main maintainers, not the full list.

funding.description: A list of URLs to provide funding to the package authors for maintenance and development of new functionality. Each entry consists of 'type' (the platform through which funding can be provided, e.g. patreon, opencollective, tidelift or github) and 'url'.

type.description: The type of funding, or the platform through which funding can be provided, e.g. patreon, opencollective, tidelift or github.

url.description: URL to a website with details, and a way to fund the package.

require.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version constraints (values) that are required to run this package.

replace.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version constraints (values) that can be replaced by this package.

conflict.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version constraints (values) that conflict with this package.

provide.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version constraints (values) that this package provides in addition to this package's name.

require-dev.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version constraints (values) that this package requires for developing it (testing tools and such).

suggest.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and descriptions (values) that this package suggests work well with it (this will be suggested to the user during installation).

process-timeout.description: The timeout in seconds for process executions, defaults to 300 (5mins).

allow-plugins.description: Defaults to {}. As of Composer 2.2.0, restricts which Composer plugins are able to execute code during a Composer run. Set it to an object with package name patterns as keys; values are true to allow and false to disallow while suppressing further warnings and prompts. Can also be set to false to disallow all plugins, or true to allow all (NOT recommended).

use-include-path.description: If true, the Composer autoloader will also look for classes in the PHP include path.

use-parent-dir.description: When running Composer in a directory where there is no composer.json, if there is one present in a directory above, Composer will by default ask whether to use it instead. One of: true (always use parent if needed), false (never ask or use it) or "prompt" (ask every time), defaults to prompt.

preferred-install.description: The install method Composer will prefer to use, defaults to dist (as of Composer 2.1) and can be any of source, dist or auto. Can also be an object with package name patterns as keys for more granular install preferences.

source-fallback.description: DEPRECATED: will be removed in Composer 2.11. Defaults to false. If true, Composer will fall back to a different installation source (e.g. from dist to source) when a download fails. Automatic source fallback has security implications; do not set it unless you absolutely need it.

policy.description: Unified security and package policy configuration (security advisories, abandoned packages, malware, and custom policies). Set to false to disable all policy enforcement. Supersedes the deprecated audit.* options.

secure-http.description: Defaults to true. If set to true only HTTPS URLs are allowed to be downloaded via Composer. If you really absolutely need HTTP access to something then you can disable it, but using Let's Encrypt to get a free SSL certificate is generally a better alternative.

secure-svn-domains.description: Defaults to []. Lists domains which should be trusted/marked as using a secure Subversion/SVN transport. By default the svn:// protocol is seen as insecure and will throw. A better/safer alternative to disabling secure-http altogether.

bearer.description: A hash of domain name => bearer authentication tokens, for example {"example.org": "foo"} to authenticate using an "Authorization: Bearer foo" header.

bitbucket-oauth.description: A hash of domain name => consumers, typically {"bitbucket.org": {"consumer-key": "myKey", "consumer-secret": "mySecret"}}.

gitlab-token.description: A hash of domain name => private tokens, typically {"gitlab.com": "privatetoken"}, or an object with username and token keys for deploy tokens. The token must have api or read_api scope.

gitlab-protocol.description: A protocol to force when creating a repository URL for the source value of the package metadata. One of git or http (https is treated as a synonym for http). By default Composer generates a git-over-SSH URL for private repositories and HTTP(S) only for public.

forgejo-domains.description: A list of domains to use in forgejo mode. This is used for custom Forgejo setups, defaults to ["codeberg.org"].

forgejo-token.description: A list of domain names and username/access-tokens to authenticate against Forgejo servers, typically {"codeberg.org": {"username": "<user>", "token": "<access-token>"}}.

client-certificate.description: An object of domain name => {"local_cert": "...", "local_pk"?: "...", "passphrase"?: "..."} to provide a client certificate.

custom-headers.description: Custom HTTP headers for specific domains.

notify-on-install.description: Composer allows repositories to define a notification URL, so that they get notified whenever a package from that repository is installed. This option allows you to disable that behaviour, defaults to true.

github-protocols.description: A list of protocols to use when cloning from github.com, in priority order, defaults to ["https", "ssh", "git"].

github-oauth.description: A hash of domain name => github API oauth tokens, typically {"github.com":"<token>"}.

gitlab-oauth.description: A hash of domain name => gitlab API oauth tokens, typically {"gitlab.com":"<token>"}.

disable-tls.description: Defaults to `false`. If set to true all HTTPS URLs will be tried with HTTP instead and no network level encryption is performed. Enabling this is a security risk and is NOT recommended. The better way is to enable the php_openssl extension in php.ini.

cafile.description: A way to set the path to the openssl CA file. In PHP 5.6+ you should rather set this via openssl.cafile in php.ini, although PHP 5.6+ should be able to detect your system CA file automatically.

capath.description: If cafile is not specified or if the certificate is not found there, the directory pointed to by capath is searched for a suitable certificate. capath must be a correctly hashed certificate directory.

store-auths.description: What to do after prompting for authentication, one of: true (store), false (do not store) or "prompt" (ask every time), defaults to prompt.

platform.description: This is a hash of package name (keys) and version (values) that will be used to mock the platform packages on this machine.

platform-check.description: Defaults to "php-only" which only checks the PHP version. Set to true to also check the presence of required PHP extensions. If set to false, Composer will not create and require a platform_check.php file as part of the autoloader bootstrap.

vendor-dir.description: The location where all packages are installed, defaults to "vendor".

bin-dir.description: The location where all binaries are linked, defaults to "vendor/bin".

data-dir.description: The location where old phar files are stored, defaults to "$COMPOSER_HOME" except on XDG Base Directory compliant unixes. Should be writable only by the user that owns the Composer installation.

cache-dir.description: The location where all caches are located, defaults to "$COMPOSER_HOME/cache" on other unix systems, "$XDG_CACHE_HOME/composer" on XDG Base Directory compliant unixes, "/Users/<user>/Library/Caches/composer" on macOS and "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Composer" on windows.

cache-files-dir.description: The location where files (zip downloads) are cached, defaults to "{$cache-dir}/files".

cache-repo-dir.description: The location where repo metadata (for the composer type and VCS repos of type svn, fossil, github and bitbucket) is cached, defaults to "{$cache-dir}/repo".

cache-vcs-dir.description: The location where vcs infos (git clones, github api calls, etc. when reading vcs repos) are cached, defaults to "{$cache-dir}/vcs".

cache-read-only.description: Defaults to false. Whether to use the Composer cache in read-only mode.

cache-ttl.description: The default cache time-to-live, defaults to 15552000 (6 months).

cache-files-ttl.description: The cache time-to-live for files, defaults to the value of cache-ttl.

cache-files-maxsize.description: The cache max size for the files cache, defaults to "300MiB".

bin-compat.description: The compatibility of the binaries, defaults to "auto" (automatically guessed), can be "full" (compatible with both Windows and Unix-based systems) or "proxy" (only create bash/Unix-style proxy files, no .bat files even on Windows/WSL).

discard-changes.description: The default style of handling dirty updates, defaults to false and can be any of true, false or "stash".

autoloader-suffix.description: Optional string to be used as a suffix for the generated Composer autoloader. When null a random one will be generated.

optimize-autoloader.description: Always optimize when dumping the autoloader.

prepend-autoloader.description: If false, the composer autoloader will not be prepended to existing autoloaders, defaults to true.

classmap-authoritative.description: If true, the composer autoloader will not scan the filesystem for classes that are not found in the class map, defaults to false.

apcu-autoloader.description: Defaults to false. If true, the Composer autoloader will check for APCu and use it to cache found/not-found classes when the extension is enabled.

github-domains.description: A list of domains to use in github mode. This is used for GitHub Enterprise setups, defaults to ["github.com"].

github-expose-hostname.description: Defaults to true. If set to false, the OAuth tokens created to access the github API will have a date instead of the machine hostname.

gitlab-domains.description: A list of domains to use in gitlab mode. This is used for custom GitLab setups, defaults to ["gitlab.com"].

archive-format.description: The default archiving format when not provided on cli, defaults to "tar".

archive-dir.description: The default archive path when not provided on cli, defaults to ".".

htaccess-protect.description: Defaults to true. If set to false, Composer will not create .htaccess files in the Composer home, cache, and data directories.

lock.description: Defaults to true. If set to false, Composer will not create a composer.lock file and will ignore it if one is present.

bump-after-update.description: Defaults to false and can be any of true, false, "dev" or "no-dev". If set to true, Composer will run the bump command after running the update command.

allow-missing-requirements.description: Defaults to false. If set to true, Composer will allow install when the lock file is not up to date with the latest changes in composer.json.

update-with-minimal-changes.description: Defaults to false. If set to true, Composer will only perform absolutely necessary changes to transitive dependencies during update.

extra.description: Arbitrary extra data that can be used by plugins, for example, package of type composer-plugin may have a 'class' key defining an installer class name.

autoload.description: Description of how the package can be autoloaded.

psr-0.description: This is a hash of namespaces (keys) and the directories they can be found into (values, can be arrays of paths) by the autoloader.

psr-4.description: This is a hash of namespaces (keys) and the PSR-4 directories they can map to (values, can be arrays of paths) by the autoloader.

classmap.description: This is an array of directories that contain classes to be included in the class-map generation process.

files.description: This is an array of files that are always required on every request.

exclude-from-classmap.description: This is an array of patterns to exclude from autoload classmap generation. (e.g. "exclude-from-classmap": ["/test/", "/tests/", "/Tests/"]

autoload-dev.description: Description of additional autoload rules for development purpose (eg. a test suite).

psr-0.description: This is a hash of namespaces (keys) and the directories they can be found into (values, can be arrays of paths) by the autoloader.

psr-4.description: This is a hash of namespaces (keys) and the PSR-4 directories they can map to (values, can be arrays of paths) by the autoloader.

classmap.description: This is an array of directories that contain classes to be included in the class-map generation process.

files.description: This is an array of files that are always required on every request.

archive.description: Options for creating package archives for distribution.

name.description: Allows configuring base name for archive. By default (if not configured, and --file is not passed as command-line argument), preg_replace('#[^a-z0-9-_]#i', '-', name) is used.

exclude.description: A list of patterns for paths to exclude or include if prefixed with an exclamation mark.

repositories.description: A set of additional repositories where packages can be found.

minimum-stability.description: The minimum stability the packages must have to be install-able. Possible values are: dev, alpha, beta, RC, stable.

prefer-stable.description: If set to true, stable packages will be preferred to dev packages when possible, even if the minimum-stability allows unstable packages.

bin.description: A set of files that should be treated as binaries and symlinked into bin-dir (from config).

include-path.description: DEPRECATED: A list of directories which should get added to PHP's include path. This is only present to support legacy projects, and all new code should preferably use autoloading.
include-path.deprecated: Deprecated: only present to support legacy projects, prefer autoloading; no removal scheduled.

scripts.description: Scripts listeners that will be executed before/after some events.

pre-install-cmd.description: Occurs before the install command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-install-cmd.description: Occurs after the install command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-update-cmd.description: Occurs before the update command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-update-cmd.description: Occurs after the update command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-status-cmd.description: Occurs before the status command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-status-cmd.description: Occurs after the status command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-package-install.description: Occurs before a package is installed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-package-install.description: Occurs after a package is installed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-package-update.description: Occurs before a package is updated, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-package-update.description: Occurs after a package is updated, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-package-uninstall.description: Occurs before a package has been uninstalled, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-package-uninstall.description: Occurs after a package has been uninstalled, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

pre-autoload-dump.description: Occurs before the autoloader is dumped, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-autoload-dump.description: Occurs after the autoloader is dumped, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-root-package-install.description: Occurs after the root-package is installed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

post-create-project-cmd.description: Occurs after the create-project command is executed, contains one or more Class::method callables or shell commands.

scripts-descriptions.description: Descriptions for the custom commands defined in scripts, shown by composer list and composer run -l instead of the default 'Runs the ... script as defined in composer.json'.

scripts-aliases.description: Alternate names for the custom commands defined in scripts, as an array of strings per script. Available as of Composer 2.7.

php-ext.description: Settings for a PHP extension package, read by PIE (https://github.com/php/pie) rather than by Composer itself. Can only be set by packages whose type is php-ext or php-ext-zend.

irc.description: IRC channel for support, as irc://server/channel.

source.description: URL to browse or download the sources.

security.description: URL to the vulnerability disclosure policy (VDP).

non-feature-branches.description: A set of string or regex patterns for non-numeric branch names that will not be handled as feature branches.

abandoned.description: Indicates whether this package has been abandoned, it can be boolean or a package name/URL pointing to a recommended alternative. Defaults to false.

_comment.description: Top level key used as a place to store comments (it can be a string or array of strings).
